# Nominal medial polygon kernel

Unmodified Angus Johnson Clipper2 C++ 1.5.4 source, pinned by the archive and file
hashes in `source-manifest.json`. Upstream: https://github.com/AngusJohnson/Clipper2/releases/tag/Clipper2_1.5.4.
Boost Software License 1.0; see `LICENSE` and retained source headers.

The ordinary V-carve baseline requires the native kernel's offset/union behavior.
The existing C# 1.4.0 kernel remains the authority for physical machining domains.
The C# port's concave-join output differs on identical integer sites; native
construction matches the supplied WASM without deleting those differences later.

`RW.Toolpaths/native/medial_polygons` supplies a small ownership-safe C ABI.
Build with its `build.ps1` or CMake. Windows uses the same MSVC runtime as Boost.
